evidence: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was performed with an Augerscan-PHI5300. A conventional Al Kα anode was used at 10 kV and 15 mA as the source of X-ray radiation. The pressure in the analysis chamber during measurements was maintained at 9 × 10−10 mbar. The energy scale was defined by setting the C 1s binding energy for the omnipresent airborne hydrocarbons to 284.6 eV. Raman spectra on the synthesized MoS2 films were measured with a HORIBA XploRA Raman spectrometer using 532 nm laser excitation, and groove density of the grating is 1,200 g/mm. A 3D AFM image of ALD-grown MoS2 film on an 10 μm × 10 μm area, with the roughness RMS of this region being 0.479 nm.
